verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Kick ships built-in AI agents (for example, automated categorization), so it could plausibly consume external MCP tools. However, every MCP item in the evidence describes Kick acting as an MCP server for outside assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Nothing shows Kick acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers, and server-side evidence cannot be credited for this client-side story.
